name: TRC
recent: TRC 近期获得两项合约：一项价值 RM150mil 的超大规模数据中心合约，以及通过联营公司获得价值 RM2.69bil 的槟城 LRT 跨海工程合约。同时，董事与主要股东出现股权变动，包括董事减持与增持。
notable: 获得价值 RM150mil 的超大规模数据中心合约。
联营公司获得价值 RM2.69bil 的槟城 LRT 跨海工程合约。
执行董事 Dato Richard Khoo Teng San 在公开市场增持公司股份。
risks: 主席 Tan Sri Dr Ahmad Kamarulzaman bin Ahmad Badaruddin 在公开市场减持 560,100 股。
主要股东 Dato Leong Kam Heng 出现股权变动申报。

recent_en: TRC recently secured two contracts: a RM150mil hyperscale data centre contract and, through a joint venture, a RM2.69bil Penang LRT cross-sea works contract. Meanwhile, there were changes in directors' and substantial shareholders' interests, including both disposals and acquisitions by directors.
notable_en: Secured a RM150mil hyperscale data centre contract.
A joint venture secured a RM2.69bil Penang LRT cross-sea works contract.
Executive Director Dato Richard Khoo Teng San acquired shares in the open market.
risks_en: Chairman Tan Sri Dr Ahmad Kamarulzaman bin Ahmad Badaruddin disposed of 560,100 shares in the open market.
Substantial shareholder Dato Leong Kam Heng had changes in shareholding reported.
